values.meaning: Map of the owner's input settings on a successful read. Individual values are null when unobserved. Keys are keyboard_layout, keyboard_variant, key_repeat, repeat_delay_ms, repeat_interval_ms, natural_scroll, tap_to_click, pointer_speed, accel_profile, left_handed, disable_while_typing and scroll_factor.

sources.meaning: Source label or declaration path for each value; none means no observation.

base.meaning: Path of the selected base input declaration.

readonly.meaning: When Sway is unavailable, input names mapped to the read-only reason.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Literal outcomes emitted by the stop and its envelope reader. The envelope reader can also emit missing envelope kernel keys: followed by the comma-joined missing keys. Unnormalized exception text can also be returned; those values are not a finite enum.
